claims.claim: You can apply or do this online.
claims.note: The text never says the exemption can be claimed online; it says a first-time claim has to be made at a Post Office, and other changes of tax class are made at a Post Office or by post.

claims.claim: Eligibility rests on getting the enhanced rate mobility component of PIP or the higher rate mobility component of DLA.
claims.quote: higher rate mobility component of Disability Living Allowance ( DLA ) enhanced rate mobility component of Personal Independence Payment ( PIP )
claims.note: Both qualifying awards are listed under eligibility for the vehicle tax exemption.

claims.claim: A PIP or DLA award letter is needed as evidence for the exemption.
claims.quote: a letter or statement from the Department for Work and Pensions that shows your PIP rate and the dates you’re getting it
claims.note: A DWP letter showing the PIP rate is listed only for the 50% reduction, not the exemption, and no DLA award letter is mentioned.

claims.claim: The vehicle registration document (V5C) is needed.
claims.quote: the V5C registration certificate (log book) in your name, if you have one
claims.note: The V5C is listed among documents to bring when changing a vehicle into or out of an exempt tax class.
